body:
> I expect it will use the page in the url as the starting point and only display a single page. I will integrate this in an example so that we can see what's going on.

I guess as for infiniteHits example we could force the example to NOT use the page parameter when syncing or creating URLS. So that the behavior is always the same. Stateful (scroll) pagination + infinite hits is something we might not want to try to solve, yet. (Twitter fails at this for example)
